selectionPolicy.definition: Sum of all faces except largest in each actually cut source component, divided by total parent planar area; not geodesic area or a fixed left/right-bank classification. Never removes fragments.
selectionPolicy.danglingDefinition: Existing generator diagnostic inspected against numerical roundoff; a selection triage threshold, no geometry or coverage tolerance change.
selectionPolicy.finalAdmission: offline_candidate is eligible for combined-pack integration review only; not loader authentication or deployment approval.
